LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNAPrimitiveWeapons.label: Primitive aphrodisiac nanofluid weapons
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNAPrimitiveWeapons.description: Draw on traditional weapon-poisoning techniques to make simple alterations to familiar weapons and ammunition, exploring the use of aphrodisiac nanofluid to subdue enemies and slaves. Blades and arrowheads are immersed so that the purple fluid evenly permeates the metal surface, then carried into the body through stab or projectile wounds. These are early experiments under low-tech conditions: they depend on landing a hit and cannot reliably avoid additional trauma.
